answer: Each of 90 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. Entry needs reservoir keeper log: levels kept at one reservoir across years of supply seasons. The karst check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The registry is consulted again every epoch, and a record that does not match the issuer's own books ends the seat. The anchor record is public, the plume cost is per identity, and 90 aliases cost 90 times one honest seat.
